d:
Get ready to enjoy the playful charm and irresistible rhythm of "Aao Na, Gale Laga Lo Na" from the 1972 Bollywood film Mere Jeevan Saathi! Featuring the charismatic Rajesh Khanna and the ever-glamorous Helen, this lively song comes alive with the unmistakable voice of Asha Bhosle.
Aao Na, Gale Laga Lo Na | Mere Jeevan Saathi (1972) |Asha Bhosle |Rajesh Khanna |Helen Superhit Song
Song: Aao Na, Gale Laga Lo Na
Movie: Mere Jeevan Saathi (1972)
Star Cast: Rajesh Khanna, Helen
Singer: Asha Bhosle
Music Director: R.D Burman
Lyricist: Majrooh Sultanpuri
